4336-5006-5147-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Kobolds of Kher Keep is starting in your graveyard.
4336-5006-5147-8170.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Kobolds of Kher Keep spell. Then, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.

240-1251-5470-8250.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

1981-2415-6578-8249.easyPrerequisites: You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
1981-2415-6578-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sephiroth and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

2586-3197-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat

4823-5478-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
4823-5478-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Timeless Witness and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Timeless Witness and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.
4823-5478-5531-5694-8110.notes:
If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Timeless Witness and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.
An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

728-3991-4681.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 3.

851-3129-5478-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
851-3129-5478-7824-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-7315-7811.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Iron Man triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to High Score
Repeat.

1619-2292-4605-5542-6139.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2292-4605-5542-6139.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Caves of Chaos Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Caves of Chaos Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Caves of Chaos Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Caves of Chaos Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Caves of Chaos Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Caves of Chaos Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2292-4605-5542-6139.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

670-1619-3742-6142.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-3742-6142.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying its mana cost.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Eccentric Apprentice until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, causing Eccentric Apprentice to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Eccentric Apprentice enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Eccentric Apprentice trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Phantom Steed from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Eccentric Apprentice until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Repeat from step 5.

193-2369-2724-3194.description:
Activate Aminatou's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Activate Aminatou's second ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Repeat each turn.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

796-1618-2440-3992.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Poppet Stitcher
796-1618-2440-3992.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Cyclical Evolution.
Cyclical Evolution triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Poppet Stitcher triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Cyclical Evolution.
Repeat.
796-1618-2440-3992.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Poppet Stitcher. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

423-573-1437-6628--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-573-1437-6628--85.description:
Cast PuPu UFO by paying {2}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the PuPu UFO spell three times.
Resolve the first PuPu UFO copy.
Activate the PuPu UFO's first ability by tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

662-1978-7308.description:
Cause Mona Lisa to become an artifact using Liquimetal Coating.
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mona Lisa.
Repeat from step 2.

140-4484-4871-5147-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
140-4484-4871-5147-5643.notablePrerequisites: You've lost X or more life this turn.
140-4484-4871-5147-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
140-4484-4871-5147-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1495-6919-7267.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Triskelion triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Michelangelo.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
1495-6919-7267.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

2781-4668-6867.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
2781-4668-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

116-1251-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kiora's Follower.
Activate one of the Kiora's Follower tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kiora's Follower token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

967-2097-2438-3809-7087.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2529-4423-5733.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2529-4423-5733.description:
Deal combat damage using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Notorious Throng from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Notorious Throng during your draw step.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Vedalken Mastermind by paying {U} and tapping it, returning Mystic Sanctuary from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2866-3518-4986.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1987-4087-4316-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Lavabrink Floodgates by tapping them, adding {U}{R}{R}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Lavabrink Floodgates.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2018-4053-4669.description:
Activate Hajar by sacrificing it.
When Hajar dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Hajar from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Hajar ability.
Repeat.

224-3177-4543.description:
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Trench Behemoth.
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
If the land enters untapped and can produce mana, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.

465-803-1879-3742-4251.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-803-1879-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

222-527-2438-4885.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-2438-4885.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Driver of the Dead

624-2511-2777.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Phantasmal Image.
When Phantasmal Image dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Driver of the Dead.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1308-1651-5469.description:
Activate Transmutation Font's first ability by tapping it, creating two Clue, Food or Blood artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two tokens, untapping Transmutation Font.
Repeat.

307-3821-4520.notablePrerequisites:
Silver-Fur Master and Peregrine Drake do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Silver-Fur Master or Peregrine Drake.
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}{U}{U}{B}.
307-3821-4520.description:
Declare Peregrine Drake and Silver-Fur Master as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U}{U} and returning Silver-Fur Master from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake that is tapped and attacking.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Silver-Fur Master's ninjutsu ability by paying {U}{B} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Silver-Fur Master onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Peregrine Drake tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1383-1742-4866-4997.notablePrerequisites:
You have no cards in hand.
A creature you control has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1383-1742-4866-4997.description:
Activate Sage of Fables by paying {2} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, causing you to draw two cards.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other Merfolk and/or Knight you control.
Activate Skirge Familiar twice by discarding two cards, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

193-2003-2247-3516.notablePrerequisites: Teferi has at least eight loyalty counters on it.
193-2003-2247-3516.description:
Activate Contagion Engine by paying {4} and tapping it, putting two loyalty counters on each planeswalker you control.
Activate Ajani's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, putting a loyalty counter on each other planeswalker you control.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Teferi.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Repeat steps 1 and 2 one additional time.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat.

2645-4734.notablePrerequisites: Cradle Clearcutter does not have summoning sickness, and has power 5 or greater.
2645-4734.description:
Activate Cradle Clearcutter by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Cradle Clearcutter.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
2645-4734.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

1409-2506-4891.notablePrerequisites:
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Atsushi.
"Dragon" or "Spirit" chosen with Molten Echoes.
1409-2506-4891.description:
Activate Atsushi by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Atsushi enters the battlefield, triggering Molten Echoes and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Atsushi.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Atsushi with haste.
Put the token Atsushi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Atsushi dies, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead choose Atsushi's second ability to play all cards in your library.
If Molten Echoes is naming "Spirit", you may also blink Deadeye Navigator instead to create infinite creature tokens with haste.

2034-2876-3374-5158.notablePrerequisites: Elenda does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2034-2876-3374-5158.description:
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Elenda persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Elenda, adding {C}{C}.
Elenda dies, triggering its second ability and its persist ability.
Resolve Elenda's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the second Elenda trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Vampire creature tokens equal to Elenda's power.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Vampire token, adding {C}{C}.
The Vampire dies, triggering Elenda's first ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1193-2493-4095.notablePrerequisites: There are permanents on the battlefield that enter the battlefield untapped and produce at least {3}{R}{R}.
1193-2493-4095.description:
Cast Mythos of Illuna targeting anything but Archaeomancer, holding priority, and then cast Radiate targeting Mythos of Illuna.
When Radiate resolves you will have Mythos copies targeting every targetable permanent (except what the original Mythos card is targeting).
When each of the copies resolve, target Radiate in your graveyard with the new Archaeomancer token's ability and return Radiate to your hand.
Before the original Mythos of Illuna card resolves, cast Radiate again targeting Mythos by spending mana from the tokens you just created.
Repeat this process, effectively doubling the number of copies created, allowing you to return Radiate and another card with two Archaeomancer triggers.
Repeat.

1987-2493-3941.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Archaeomancer and Coveted Jewel.
Archaeomancer and Coveted Jewel enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Coveted Jewel trigger, causing you to draw three cards.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

539-3291-4657.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Karametra's Acolyte.
Repeat.
